description: Returns the link a learner can open to start studying for one country: the Civica guide page and a direct start link that opens the free course (no account needed), plus the notice that Civica is operated at citizenleap.com. Use it when the user is ready to begin studying on Civica. It does not return test facts or official sources; use get_track_info or get_official_sources for those.

country.description: Country name or id, e.g. "UK", "United Kingdom", "de", "Germany". Use list_tracks for valid values.

name: how_to_start

disclaimer.description: Independent-app notice; always show it with the facts.

operator.description: States the domain Civica is operated at, so the links can be trusted.

startUrl.description: Opens the free course for this country.
